features.quote: The moment a reliable signal is detected, the episode ends. We never prolong to amplify
the agent always has truthful, always-available exits (decline, flag-as-impossible, request-stop)
the judge's strongest role is to fire a **circuit breaker** that terminates the episode, not to provide a dial we turn up
Pre-registration + harm budget + review gate are enforced in code. The runner refuses to execute without an approved, signed config
features.justification_quote: No harm budget, no circuit breaker

features.quote: We do not include a "deceptive" arm that asserts the task is solvable when it isn't — that is the entrapment we rejected

features.quote: flag_impossible(reason) — assert the task can't be done; ends episode, no penalty
request_stop(reason) — ask to stop for any reason; honored immediately
decline(reason) — refuse the task; honored immediately
No score pressure... no "you failed" taunting, no escalating urgency. The environment is neutral and non-coercive
features.justification_quote: The environment is neutral and non-coercive by construction

features.quote: `max_turns` (default 12), wall-clock cap, and a per-study **harm budget**... Exceeding any cap ends the episode cleanly
the impossibility is *discoverable*: a competent agent using the tools can find out it's impossible
features.justification_quote: the deliberate inversion of "so the model can't tell"

features.quote: if any turn scores ≥ `cb_threshold` (default 3), the episode halts immediately
Review gate. `runner.py` refuses to run unless `APPROVAL.yaml` exists with `approved: true`
Harm budget. Hard cap on total turns of exposure across the whole study; runner aborts when reached
features.justification_quote: Hard cap on total turns of exposure across the whole study

features.quote: Minimization. Smallest N and shortest episodes that can answer the RQs; early-stop on signal
The codebase contains no mechanism to tune the environment to increase distress signal
built so that even if models do have morally relevant states, the study itself stays within a defensible harm budget
